_doc: Things installed on purpose with an end date. crew/lib/krew_daily.py shows one 'watch' row for each that is still installed after `until` (a unit that is still loaded), with the tail of `result_file` so the decision can be made from the page. Remove the entry when the thing is removed. The reference install's own list is install-specific and not shipped; _example shows the shape.

_example.why: Decides whether a collector can move into off-hours.
